title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Zinc launches a hosted MCP server for retail ordering (Nov 18): every order needs a max_price ceiling and an idempotency key
bullets.summary: Zinc's hosted MCP server (mcp.zinc.com/mcp) plus GET /search and POST /orders APIs let agents buy across Amazon, Lowe's, Walmart, Best Buy, The Home Depot and Etsy; each order must carry a hard price ceiling in cents and an idempotency key so retries never double-buy.
bullets.how: The Construct: copy the pattern for every spending agent (a price ceiling the agent cannot raise plus an idempotency key per order). Brand 9 Signs: apply it to the Signs365 partner-order runner and to buying install supplies (Home Depot/Lowe's). PRAGMA: a clean, citable example of a safe agent-purchase contract.

bullets.title: Proof ships its MCP server in ChatGPT's app directory (Nov 18), starting with x401 biometric approval of agent actions
bullets.summary: The first flow lets a person approve an agent's action with a biometric and lets the receiving business verify that signature, so the agent can prove who it acts for and what was approved; it builds on the x401 open protocol launched Oct 15.
bullets.how: The Construct: watch for a Claude connector; a signed human approval is the missing piece for high-value sends and spends. PRAGMA: pairs with this week's bank agent-liability terms as a governance pitch. Brand 9 Signs: later, signed customer approval of proofs and quotes.

bullets.title: Linq raises a $90M Series B led by a16z (Nov 18) for infrastructure that lets AI agents text and call
bullets.summary: Ben Horowitz joins the board; the round is 4.5x the $20M Series A from February, and Dealroom reports a $1B valuation that Linq has not confirmed.
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs: an option for agent-run order, proof and shipping texts to customers and builders. The Construct: a possible SMS/voice channel for Hermes workers. PRAGMA: shows investors backing the 'agents where customers already are' layer.

bullets.title: Anthropic's first day on Nasdaq (Nov 19): CNN reports a $1.76T valuation after the $83 IPO price
bullets.summary: Trading as ANT after pricing above range at $83 (about $1.5T at pricing), Anthropic closed its debut valued at about $1.76T per CNN; first-day close price was not independently verified in this scan.
bullets.how: The Construct: the core vendor now answers to public markets, so keep model-neutral fallbacks tested and watch for pricing or rate-limit changes. PRAGMA: credibility for Claude-based operator stacks. Brand 9 Signs: no direct effect.

praxis_lesson: Zinc's order contract (a hard max_price the agent cannot raise plus an idempotency key on every order) is the cheapest safety pattern for any Construct agent that spends money; add both to the Signs365 runner before adding any new purchasing agent.
